translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Kristo Kibego Okorake Ea wane Kine Pauloŋo Edange
Kimakopne, na Anutu wane san qabuine wele ea ŋidanikalane ŋinano sarikole, naso yewao na don kiroroine so dereret suaine ea ra mi ŋidangole.
Na ŋinane keuo ge more na wetne maingewe paki yeye kine kine qeligewe niget nangi Yesu Kristo kibego seukke, eŋeka weku detka kalane wetkekole.
Eso na ŋinano sarikole, naso yewao na zonomne midaki, kaet okanbe zonomne korop oreke.

Pakiso na don rakole so Kisi Mayakatne ra qelaŋane ŋidangole, ea na ŋei dereretko ŋine mi ma more ŋidangole, so wet ŋine maingeu paki naŋane don desikei wane, midaka, na Anutu Asuinane zonom ea ra wakone sikan ŋungole.
Ea wane ŋinane wetŋo ŋei dereretko misuk motpi payake, midakaka! Anutu wane zonomgo motpi payake.
Anutu Wane Asuŋo Dereret Ŋebon Okanmaike

Welekatne, na don dereret inerop ea wane kine ra wakone, ŋei mo Anutu wane zonomgo togole gemami, eŋe edan okanmaile. Ŋo eamo kepe iwa wane dereretine midakaka, me kepe iwa waremami eŋane zonom, eamo midaka. Zonom me dereret yewa mo kieke mida lele more siuk wareake.
Na dereret pa ra wakone ŋidanmaile, yemo Anutu wane dereret sane, motkeki sanka pa sake, Anutu eŋe mo ŋenane qeli ewe zonom okaniakane mokaka kepe iwa mi ma wakonge yewao biŋek qeke.
Kepe iwa wane ŋei waomine eŋe dereret iwa mane mi detkakoi. Eŋe ea mane detkakoi ra yemo eŋe qeli ewe zonom wane Waom kibego mi qeurap.
Ea wane Anutu wane papiaŋo iwa yale ramaike,

content.text: “Yeye kine kine deŋo mi kakaine, me ketŋo mi dereretne, me ŋei wetene lotkeki mi detkoi, kine kine yewa yemo ŋei korop Anutu wetŋo qotka lukka more eŋane detpi wele lele okanmaike, ŋei yewa eŋane biŋek ebonge.”

content: Ŋo ŋene yemo Anutu eŋine san qabuinane kine eŋine Asuineŋo ra wakone ŋedange, Asuŋo yeye kine kine korop ka waremaike, so Anutu wane san qabuinane kine qeirop ea yaleka kamaike.

Ma ŋeiŋo ŋei mane wane wetinane kine desiake? I midakaka! Ŋei wane eŋe eŋine wetino metmaike, oŋomka eŋane kineine det kamaike, rokop yale waka ŋei maneŋo Anutu wetinane kine mi desiake, Anutu Asuineŋo ka weku Anutu eŋine wetinane kine korop det wareake.
Ŋene Asu pa ŋebonmaike, iwa mo kepeo ŋei eŋano ŋine mi makone, ŋene Anutuŋo Asuine ŋebongi makone, ea yemo Anutuŋo ŋene kine kine korop ŋebonge, ea wane maine detluk kaikenane okan ŋonge.
Eso ea wane ŋene kepe ŋei dereretko ŋine don mi ra ŋidanmaine, midaka! Ŋene Asuŋo dereret ŋebonmaike, paki, ŋene don wele ea wane kine ra qelaŋane more ŋei Asurop gemami, eŋe edanmaine.

Ŋei mane Asu midaine geake eŋe Anutu wane Asu eŋano ŋine bakom sarimaike, ea mane mi mayake. Onoka wane ŋei yaline eŋe don ea wane kine welekatne mi dere qelaŋan kamaike, ea wane, pakimo don yewa detki qelaŋ don wele midaine okaniake, eamo, Asurop ŋoku dereretne okanmaike.
Ŋei Asurop eŋe yeye kine kine korop dere wesakkei, ŋo ŋei Asu midaineŋo ŋei Asurop eŋane kine maine mi desiake, ŋaŋaeyake.
Ea wane Anutu wane Papiaŋo iwa yale ramaike,

content.text: “Maŋo Waom wet bonepinane don detmaike? Maŋo eweke more Anutu numa sikankaki desiake?”

content: Ŋene Asurop, yemo Kristo wet bonepinane don ma gemaine.
